Definition: to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cover, purge, make an atonement, make reconciliation, cover over with pitch; 1a) (Qal) to coat or cover with pitch; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cover over, pacify, propitiate; 1b2) to cover over, atone for sin, make atonement for; 1b3) to cover over, atone for sin and persons by legal rites; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be covered over; 1c2) to make atonement for; 1d) (Hithpael) to be covered
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
